exactSupportingSpans.heading: The basic concepts
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Outfinitism is the term proposed here. It sharpens the meta-rational impulse by organizing it around the systematic study of limits: the limits of theories, models, measurements, institutions, technologies, categories, and our own capacities.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A metacult, and this metacult
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A conventional cult protects its center from doubt. A metacult makes the capacity to doubt its own center part of what it protects.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: The Outfinitist Metacult: Belonging Built on Fallibility
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A metacult is a voluntary, decentralized, and self-correcting culture that turns broad, revisable commitments into repeated practices, mutual support, institutional memory, and collective action.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A founder presents an AI system for selecting job candidates. Instead of asking only whether the model is accurate, the group maps its limits. On which population was it validated? Which errors are most costly? Who can appeal? Which data are absent? Is a non-automated route available?

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A machine-learning specialist sees technical limits. A lawyer sees rights. A person recently subjected to automated recruitment sees the human experience. An entrepreneur sees cost and market constraints. A psychologist sees how applicants may change behavior under evaluation. No perspective is sufficient alone.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: The founder who refuses the role of prophet
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Founding texts should be open to annotation, contestable, and replaceable by later editions.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: The founder who refuses the role of prophet
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Members should be able to demonstrate that the founder is wrong without being treated as enemies of the project.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: Local power, global memory, and the right to fork
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The network should preserve versions of rules, decisions, arguments, experiments, and outcomes.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: Local power, global memory, and the right to fork
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Members should be able to export evidence of work, recommendations, and materials to which they have rights. Intimate data must not travel automatically.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: A day in an Outfinitist circle
exactSupportingSpans.quote: Someone needs an independent evaluator. Someone has closed a company and needs a professional recommendation that does not translate closure into stigma.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: Protections against success
exactSupportingSpans.quote: A small project may appear virtuous because nothing valuable can yet be captured. The real test begins when money, reputation, access, and political relevance arrive.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: Protections against success
exactSupportingSpans.quote: The defense is publication of power relations, access to minutes, limited mandates, independent audits, and, in some contexts, randomly selected members alongside relevant expertise.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: Protections against success
exactSupportingSpans.quote: If such practices become systemic and cannot be corrected, the organization should close, rename, or be forked openly.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: The direction of the Outfinitist metacult
exactSupportingSpans.quote: It insists on equal dignity and on matching authority to demonstrated competence, limited scope, visible responsibility, and revocability.

exactSupportingSpans.heading: An invitation, not an oath
exactSupportingSpans.quote: She returns when that value proves repeatable. She contributes if others benefit.

artMeaning: The book’s evolutionary-debate opening enacts attention rewarding a quick interruption rather than the branching explanation. Returning attention to the evidence leads into an equal-height voluntary circle; temporary facilitation passes away from the initially confident speaker. No dignity ranking or actual reported meeting.

The hypothetical recruiting case moves from an AI device to validation population, a rejected applicant’s missing appeal destination, and a possible human route. Different questions affect who may exercise authority. Nothing asserts a real population defect, implemented remedy or measured fairness outcome.

Correction visibly preserves Edition 1 beside Edition 2. On departure a permitted contribution record and recommendation move toward the member; a labelled private envelope and both historical editions remain. A closed-project box makes the practical value of unstigmatized support visible, without promising clinical services or project success.

Prestige makes questioning an elevated leader difficult. The conceptual proposed response actually lowers the platform, ends a mandate and moves facilitation to another person while the former leader keeps equal standing. Closing on the real circle and success-protections sections invites judging the proposal rather than joining it.
epistemicLimits: Outfinitism and metacult remain proposals, not an established field or functioning organization.
No intelligence caste or dignity ranking.
The source asks about validation population, appeal and alternatives; visual questions do not claim a particular dataset defect or implemented solution.
Portable contribution evidence excludes private data and assets without rights.
